title: Extended word RAM instructions
statement: An extended word RAM instruction is either an ordinary word RAM instruction, a request to read input position $j$ into register $i$, an instruction to emit the bit in register $i$, an instruction to consume a random bit into register $i$, or an instruction to divide the word in register $i$ by two and place the result in register $j$. The indices for these additional instructions are integers.
